description: Animate Music Videos with Krikey AI Animation. Select a 3D character, a music genre, and a topic (for example a birthday card, a marketing video or a how-to tutorial), then animate your cartoon character using AI Text to Animation. Download a high-res video export and share these 3D visuals with AI-generated music, animations, anime and cute cartoon characters.
